title: NYC Core Official GIS Catalog
description: A reusable real-data catalog for agent-planned NYC vector analysis. It exposes buildings, Broadway centerlines, rivers, Community Districts, and an audited Lower Manhattan building subset without prescribing an analysis workflow.
publishers: NYC Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications

layers.name: buildings
layers.description: 360 official Manhattan building footprints for general inspection and spatial analysis.

layers.name: roads
layers.description: Official NYC street centerline features covering Broadway and nearby roads.

layers.name: rivers
layers.description: Hudson River and East River polygons derived reproducibly from official NYC land/water boundaries.

layers.name: lower_manhattan_buildings
layers.description: 133 audited Lower Manhattan building footprints with construction-year and roof-height attributes.
